trends.name: Iran-US Military Escalation & Strait of Hormuz
trends.summary: Escalating tensions between Iran and US military forces near Strait of Hormuz with Iranian Parliament approving fees on passage, Turkish reports of Iranian missiles near NATO airspace, and White House indicating 4-6 week timeline for potential action. Iran has agreed to some US points in private talks but anything agreed will be tested. This directly impacts oil supply constraints and global energy markets.

trends.name: Oil Price Surge & Energy Market Volatility
trends.summary: Brent crude heads for record monthly surge with WTI settling above $100 for first time since 2022, driven by Strait of Hormuz closure fears. Crude oil in floating storage surged 47% in past week with Middle East on-sea storage up 298%, signaling supply disruption concerns. Airlines like JetBlue raising baggage fees as fuel costs soar.

trends.name: AI Valuation Correction & Tech Sector Pressure
trends.summary: Nvidia valuation falls to S&P 500 parity for first time in over a decade amid broader AI enthusiasm cooling. Small-cap tech (ex-software) down significantly alongside energy sector weakness. BofA identifies select AI growth stocks as best positioning, but market is repricing expectations for AI mega-cap returns.

trends.name: CTA Systematic Selling Capitulation Signal
trends.summary: Commodity Trading Advisors have sold $85 billion in US equities over 30 trading sessions—the largest 30-day sale, suggesting systematic selling may be running out of steam. This could signal potential market stabilization or rebound opportunity as algorithmic trend-following exhausts.

trends.name: China Economic Slowdown & Import Collapse
trends.summary: China on track to import only 3.69M metric tons of LNG in March—lowest since 2018, down 45% from January and 57% from December due to Strait of Hormuz closure. Combined with LNG import reduction, signals weakening Chinese demand and broader economic slowdown concerns affecting global commodity markets.

trends.name: Prediction Markets Legal Scrutiny & Regulation
trends.summary: US Federal prosecutors probing whether prediction market bets violate trading laws, while NFL asks prediction market operators to refrain from 'objectionable bets.' This emerging regulatory pressure could reshape the nascent prediction market sector and impact trading strategies.

trends.name: Fed Policy Divergence & Rate Path Uncertainty
trends.summary: Fed Chair Powell indicates inflation outlook remains in check with no need to hike rates despite oil shock, but also signals risks suggest rates could move higher or lower. This dovish stance combined with uncertainty creates volatile trading conditions; Powell's 'therapy speak' response to inflation suggests limited policy tools.

trends.name: Middle East Geopolitical Risk & Regional Destabilization
trends.summary: EU expands naval operations in Red Sea and Indian Ocean amid Iran tensions; Turkey reports Iranian missile near-miss over NATO airspace; Middle East oil producers continue selling US Treasurys. White House considering asking Arab countries to help pay for war costs, signaling broader regional involvement.

trends.name: Retirement & 401(k) Asset Expansion Into Alternatives
trends.summary: 401(k) accounts moving closer to fully embracing crypto and private equity; Labor Department proposes alternative asset rule for retirement savings. Simultaneously, retirement saver protection rule has died for second time, creating regulatory uncertainty while opening allocation options for institutional capital.

trends.name: Micron Semi Valuation Debate & Dip-Buying Opportunity
trends.summary: Conflicting analyst views on Micron: some view low P/E as value trap while others see momentum fatigue triggering cheap dip-buying opportunity. Reflects broader semiconductor sector volatility amid AI demand uncertainty and memory chip pricing pressures.

trends.name: Meta Instagram Premium Subscription & Revenue Diversification
trends.summary: Meta begins testing Instagram premium subscription offering, signaling shift toward monetizing user base through direct subscriptions beyond advertising. Represents strategic pivot for social media giant amid regulatory pressure and advertiser sentiment volatility.

trends.name: Global Shipping & Supply Chain Disruption Risk
trends.summary: Iran war impacts global shipping carriers with potential for broader supply chain disruption; China's collapsing LNG imports and Strait of Hormuz closure creating logistics bottlenecks. FlexiVan Leasing and transportation sector facing headwinds from geopolitical instability and rerouting costs.
